limitations: Design-event context: a typographic audience tolerates more abstraction than a retail audience.

title: Sharjah city brand
creator: Pentagram
problems_solved: Arabic and English treated as equals rather than one script stacked under the other

indicators.diversity_note: bilingual identity system at city scale

key_lessons: Per the search summary: shared colour, motion and form across both scripts; guidelines allow each wordmark to stand alone by context. Rule: design bilingual parity at the system level, not by forcing every lockup to carry both scripts.
limitations: Institutional budget and bespoke type; transfer the principle, not the assets.
